scoring_justification: Result-level compare because the raw intermediate artifacts (EFG tensors, total energies) are not submitted and recomputing would require re-running DFT; the paper’s computed B3LYP values serve as hidden gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the six B3LYP computed quantities (Table 2, FeP(Im)₂ row).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, B3LYP entry for bis(imidazole) heme.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Matches the values written by the reference solve.sh and are the paper’s own reported results for this exact model and functional.

delta_e_hs_ls_fe2.description: Fe(II) high-spin/low-spin energy difference in kcal mol⁻¹

delta_e_hs_ls_fe3.description: Fe(III) high-spin/low-spin energy difference in kcal mol⁻¹

delta_e_q_fe2_singlet.description: Mössbauer quadrupole splitting for ferrous singlet in mm s⁻¹

delta_e_q_fe3_doublet.description: Mössbauer quadrupole splitting for ferric doublet in mm s⁻¹

outputs.description: The six numeric results for the B3LYP bis(imidazole) model: two Fe-ligand bond lengths, two high-spin/low-spin energy differences, and two Mössbauer quadrupole splittings.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each field to the paper-reported B3LYP values with per-field tolerances. Tolerances and gold values are not disclosed to the solving agent.

steps.description: Fraction of the six numeric fields in results.json that lie within the per-field tolerance of the hidden gold values from the paper.
